note: kit-ab-smoke-1121 (feature/kit-ab-1121, docs/314): one short in-game smoke per tester-kit arm on the Steam build (Bin state apex via tools/turbo-compat.ts; bridge only). The kits' ts3fixes arm packages are installed as is; the asi is the Steam build of the kit's native code (k4: mkit2 Steam = the retail kit asi's source; e7b: m1120t Steam = the e6 EA asi's base, master m1120t + the .ooa gate). Jobs 1-3: the arm's world-load line (notice text + switch read-back), minute stats lines, 0 script errors; job 1 also pauses 20 s and saves once (kit-ab-session-check: the stats task wakes while paused, the save pause is counted apart) and screenshots the notification. Job 4 = e7b arm B: our mods off (ourMods false: ts3native pair + ts3fixes moved out, the job fails if ts3native.log appears). Correctness only, no timing. The kit's own switching, summary and uninstall are checked offline by tools/player/ts3-kit/test-kit.ps1. AGENT: build/ts3agent.package = game-copy/ts3agent.package.m1121.
